meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目新版本发布到 npm 并验证发布产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要一键把代码包发布到 npm 并确认发布成功
copy.tagline_en: Publish a new version of your project to npm and verify the outputs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ship a code package to npm and confirm it succeeded

howto.what: Claude 成为 oh-my-opencode 发布管理员:确认 patch/minor/major 后触发 GitHub Actions 的 publish 流程,核验 npm、GitHub、Discord 发布产物;不审查或修补代码。
howto.when: 当你给出 patch、minor 或 major 任一版本号类型并说要发布/部署时触发;只说 Publish、Release、Deploy 等词但不给类型时,它会停下询问。

say.text: 请发布一个 patch 版本
say.note: Claude 会触发发布流程并跟踪每个环节,最后汇报链接。

say.text: 把当前改动以 minor 版本发布到 npm
say.note: 它会先确认版本号类型,再运行并核验发布产物。

say.text: 这次改动用 major 发布,记得发 Discord 公告
say.note: 它会执行完整发布流程并尝试公告。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes the release manager for oh-my-opencode: after confirming patch/minor/major, it triggers the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifies npm, GitHub and Discord release artifacts; it won't review or fix code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to publish/deploy and provide a bump type (patch, minor, or major). If you only say publish/release/deploy without a type, Claude stops and asks for one.

say_en.note: Claude runs the workflow and verifies every artifact.

say_en.text: Release current changes as a minor version.
say_en.note: It confirms the bump, then runs and checks the publish.

say_en.text: Ship this as a major release and tell Discord.
say_en.note: It follows the full workflow including Discord announcement.
